label: Batch certification of three exploration maps
summary: Batch certification of three exploration maps (explorations/cause-of-quality-more-such.toml, efficient-cause-prior.toml, nothing-moves-except-in-act.toml). (1) The Metaphysics II.1 'cause of a quality is more such' premise from six open reception/limitation premises; the map's single 'unlimited by that recipient' step needed both directions of reception<->limitation relativized to the limiter z, plus the effect's reception of what is caused in it. It avoids q.4 a.2 preexistence, so no cycle with PERFECTION-PREEXISTENCE-FROM-CAUSAL-TRANSFER. (2) The secunda via premises 'efficient cause is prior' and 'nothing prior to itself' from a dependence analysis of priority, split into its sufficient and necessary directions so each derivation uses the weakest one; plus two side results from dependence alone: nothing is its own efficient cause (second route bypassing priority) and no mutual efficient causation. (3) The prima via 'moves only as in act' by cases on mover = moved: a distinct mover causes, so is more such, so is in act; a self-mover moves by a distinct part, which is in act by the first case, and the whole is in act through its part. This answers the self-mover gap of ATTEMPT-REJECTED-DERIVATION-LEADS-20261107 without STMT-NO-MOVER-MOVES-ITSELF-IN-ITS-RESPECT (itself derived from the target). Controls: 21 omission models from scripts/countermodel.py (Fin carriers renamed to Bool/Unit so decide is axiom-free), plus one hand-written joint witness with nonempty causing, moving, self-moving and efficient-causing relations; excluded middle has no omission model within the bounds. Rejected edges are recorded in ATTEMPT-CAUSAL-MAPS-BATCH1-REJECTED-EDGES. Semantic follow-up 2026-11-09: target99470 has the frozen diagonal MovesIn x x r antecedent, not independent SELF_MOTION_2. Corrected its label/definition selection to SELF_MOTION_1 without changing its body or old resultf01de122. Added separately typed analyst SELF_MOTION_3 (WholeParts): same whole/context, whole Moved, two distinct proper parts, internal Moves p q and explicit primitive Integrated. This is not completion of the original full sense or a verified attribution to Aristotle; original allowance remains. SelfMotionSeparation.distinctPart derives exactly target99470 from two OPEN bridges: diagonal-to-this-reconstruction and internal-mover-to-whole movement. Certificate discriminates internal-only, lifted-without-diagonal, diagonal-only, joined internal+diagonal without moving-whole, and Full; joined refutes target with reconstruction bridge, diagonal-only refutes target with transfer bridge, Full jointly satisfies both with populated motion. Whole motion/integration omissions reject mere coincident internal motion. No blanket identification of SelfMovedIn and diagonal, no actuality-to-no-self-motion feedback and no change to old theorem assumptions. Explicit comparison annotations live in specs/self-motion-separation.toml; exploration connects directly to target99470 and its existing mover-actuality/root consumer.
blocker: Every new premise is open. Supported (claim bears on it, gap noted): cause has what it gives (q.4 a.2, scoped to causes of being), received perfection is limited (q.7 a.1-2), limitation only through reception (q.7 a.1, which its claim restricts to esse: the generalization is in tension with that restriction), effect depends on its efficient cause (q.44 a.1 ad 2), self-mover moves by a distinct part (Physics VIII.4; VIII.5 unpinned). Bare analyst premises: caused perfection is had; perfection caused in another is received in it; cause's perfection not received in its effect; unlimited possession exceeds limited; efficient cause not dependent on effect; both directions of priority as nonmutual dependence; mover causes what it moves to (crosses DISAMB-CAUSE as an explicit bridge); whole in act through its part (contestable for wholes that are so only in a part). Follow-up: original SELF_MOTION_2-to-analyst-reconstruction applicability and both sufficient bridges remain OPEN. Physics VIII.4 254b27–33/255b32–33 says only some mover; no distinctness-from-whole or diagonal bridge is extracted. Integrated is a primitive with semantic applicability open, not an achieved metaphysical explanation. Whole-actuality transfer remains OPEN; no original semantic-completion reduction or root closure claimed.
